Rachna Bisht --Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand & another --Respondents
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Anil Bisht, learned Counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Anil Dabral, learned Addl. CSC for the State.
3. Petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking a direction
to respondent no.2 to consider the case of petitioner for her
transfer from Govt. Upper Primary School, Lohali, Block-Betalghat, District Nainital to Govt. Boys Upper Primary
School, Mallital, Nainital as the post of Assistant Teacher
(General Subject) is lying vacant.
4. It is the contention of petitioner that due to omission on
the part of respondent no.2, petitioner could not opt for Govt.
Boys Upper Primary School, Mallital, Nainital since such
vacancy was shown as Assistant Teacher (Science) in the web
portal of the Department. Petitioner contends that petitioner
has been working in the present place of posting since 2013
and she made an application for transfer on request for which
she exercised seven options excluding the option for Govt.
Boys Upper Primary School, Mallital, Nainital.
5. Learned State Counsel seeks 48 hours' time to get
instructions in the matter as to whether there was some fault
on the part of respondent no.2 or not, and as to whether the
seat is still vacant as on date or not.
6. Put up on 09.09.2026 as fresh.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 07.09.2026 R.Dang
